purpose: Freeze fresh generated structural cliff topology to source-authored connected contour recipes before shoreline/water work.

topology.visualResolverNeighborhood: CliffShape15 exact corner mask chooses authored rounded recipe; diagonal neighbors may remain available for future start/middle/end variants but are not required for correctness

south_lip_strip.destination: host south boundary; bottom 8px of official-demo c2r7 lip

south_straight_face.tallExtension: crest c2r7 stays on host; repeat c2r3 exactly N-1 times; emit c2r8 foot once at host+N

south_west_diagonal.projection: W14 c1 crest/body/foot; W13 west low-side receiver visibility; exact source pixels stay host-aligned

south_east_diagonal.projection: W14 c3 crest/body/foot; W13 east low-side receiver visibility; exact source pixels stay host-aligned

visualAuthority.seasonRule: season swaps the sheet while keeping identical topology/source coordinates
visualAuthority.diagonalRule: CliffShape15 remains structural authority. Mask 12/6 selects diagonal art only when a matching diagonal-neighbor mask proves an actual sampled diagonal chain; an isolated mask 12/6 remains an orthogonal corner.
visualAuthority.projectionRule: V7 owns plateau fill. W14 ordinary south presentation uses demo-grounded crest/body/foot families c2r7/c2r3/c2r8 (straight), c1r7/c1r3/c1r8 (SW), and c3r7/c3r3/c3r8 (SE). Crest stays on the host row; receiver-facing height equals structural tier delta. W13 low-side diagonal visibility is preserved.

collisionAuthority.rule: different structural levels block the shared cardinal edge

specialAttachments.base15ShapeResolverOwns: ordinary cliff edges and corners only
specialAttachments.rampPresentation: Exact left/right 3x4 authored directional ramp stamps from the companion LPC grass-top cliff sheet own ramp presentation. Fresh worldgen paints a matching six-cell MountainPath corridor; the center one-tier structural edge remains the explicit traversal opening. No transformed or fabricated ramp art is allowed.
specialAttachments.climbableVines: ElizaWy vine source spans are catalogued but not rendered as climbable until the character climb state is wired, preventing dishonest visual affordances.
specialAttachments.caves: default ordinary cave mouth is fixed authored 1-tile-wide recipe; large 3x3 portal is reserved explicit road/cart/major tunnel only

retiredComplexity: source image envelope treated as logical world footprint
narrow lip/side-strip approximation as the base cliff renderer
opaque ElizaWy plateau-fill cells rendered over V7 ground
four-neighbor mask alone selecting diagonal visual art
full 32x32 square-plateau example cells used as generic cardinal cliff overlays

generatedContourQuality.scope: fresh procedurally generated structural landforms only; explicit editor/player-authored structural levels remain untouched
rules: lower a generated threshold cell when it has zero or one same-threshold cardinal neighbor
raise a generated lower cell when three or four cardinal neighbors meet the threshold
preserve cells with two or more cardinal supports so deliberate 45-degree staircase contours remain available to ElizaWy diagonal recipes
Level 2 cleanup lowers thin terminals to Level 1 rather than deleting the underlying plateau
generatedContourQuality.reason: Three-edge/isolated generated cells project as narrow rectangular cliff posts; inverse single-cell notches create repeated concave teeth. These are rasterization artifacts, not desired macro landform shapes.
generatedContourQuality.visualPolicy: normalized-out thin caps/posts receive no generic fallback or invented pixels; explicit authored geometry remains structurally valid for feature-specific recipes
